reuse.why: Extends the existing isMonthFillCategory predicate that copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions already share, and drops its now-unneeded includeHidden option.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in the predicate; only the 'c.goal_def IS NOT NULL AS has_template' column is repeated in the three existing category queries.

placement.why: The rule lives in the month-fill predicate in server/budget/actions.ts and the data comes from the queries that feed it.

scope.why: Only the month-wide exclusion rule and its tests.

maintainability.why: One predicate with a clear comment decides which categories every month-wide action fills, and removing the includeHidden flag simplifies its interface.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep filtering through isMonthFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated has_template SQL column in getBudgetData, setZero and getAverageFillCategories is plain repetition of a data field, not reshaped logic.

one_place.where: isMonthFillCategory in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and getAverageFillCategories (set3/6/12MonthAvg).
